summary: R0 governance and R1 Runtime Integration Spine are complete. R2 bilingual NLU/dialogue is implemented and system-tested but not formally closed (two live-verification blockers require the user physically present; RISK-STRUCTURED-NLU-MODEL-QUALITY sub-finding 3 accepted as bounded risk). R3 capability registry/typed planner architectural core is implemented and tested with zero regression (ADR-038 accepted) but not complete (filesystem/URL adapters, NLU/UI reachability, planner wiring, 7-scenario demo pending). R4 computer-use productization is in_progress: its deterministic core (observation contract, beta allowlist, first production planner, resumable hash-bound confirmation, semantic postcondition verification, ADR-039 accepted) plus registry/composition wiring (computerUse.run capability registered truthfully disabled, AuraKernel.computerUseRun wired) are implemented and tested (EV-R4-20260807-PRODUCTIZATION-CORE-01, EV-R4-20260807-WIRING-REGISTRY-01; 20/20 bundles, 778/778 tests); remaining is live beta-app evidence (>=3 approved apps) requiring the user physically present. R5 browser/mail/calendar/contacts adapters is now in_progress (started by user-directed deviation); ADR-040 must be authored first. The interactive hardware demonstrations (microphone/TCC, 7-scenario, beta apps) remain unperformed and need a human physically present. All R2/R3/R4/R5 closeout and transition notes are recorded in PROGRAM_LEDGER.md, RISK_REGISTER.md, EVIDENCE_INDEX.md, DECISION_REGISTER.md, current-state.json, and ACTIVE_CONTEXT.md.

Defined strict dependency order, completion gates, tests, evidence, state transitions, and session-closeout duties for every prompt.
Created a token-aware anti-amnesia system with a five-file minimum startup set plus the active prompt.
Created schema-backed program state, capability matrix, prompt manifest, context index, session handoff, and evidence-record contracts.
Created separate append-only program ledger, decision register, risk register, and evidence index.
Seeded an audited capability matrix that distinguishes implementation, runtime registration, user reachability, and evidence level.
Verified through GitHub comparison that the suite added 38 files without modifying or deleting pre-existing files.

Confirmed that the ordered manifest intentionally contains BOOTSTRAP, R0-R12, and FINAL; 15_SESSION_CLOSEOUT.prompt.md is mandatory but outside the ordered implementation manifest.

Completed R0 with scripts/validate_runtime_completion.py, 13 deterministic governance tests, toolchain-manifest.json, TOOLCHAIN.md, ADR-045, CI governance ordering, capability-matrix audit, and synchronized decision/evidence records.

Added RuntimeHealthRegistry live change events, explicit degraded/loading/unsupported construction states, and UI health refresh through AuraAppModel.
Accepted ADR-035 and ADR-037; confirmation replay, plan-change, expiry, context-mismatch, verification, and restart fail-closed behavior are covered by tests.
Bound confirmation execution to exact structured plan fingerprints and added a changed-argument regression test.
Moved successful Chatterbox private-audio cleanup before stream completion and verified the full audio bundle remains deterministic.
Stabilized timing-sensitive Agent tests by serializing the Multi-Agent Orchestrator suite and removing an unnecessary deterministic-stop sleep without weakening assertions.
Fresh final R1 regression passed 20/20 bundles and 678/678 tests; R2 is now in progress.
Started R2 after reading the normative prompt and accepted R1 contracts; the first focused R2 gates are green.
Added DialogueLanguage/DialogueAct metadata, Turkish and mixed-language fast-path handling, DialogueEngine, and provider-neutral structured-NLU contracts.

next_action: By explicit user instruction ('bunu atlayalım sıradaki aşamaya geçelim'), the program moved to R3 while R2 stayed in_progress with two open risks (RISK-STT-MIC-NOT-CAPTURING has an unconfirmed candidate fix, EV-R2-20260804-PTT-PERMISSION-AUDIT-01, needing the user physically present to verify; RISK-STRUCTURED-NLU-MODEL-QUALITY's residual sampling variance needs an explicit accept/reject decision). R3's architectural core is now implemented and tested with zero regression: CapabilityManifest/CapabilityRegistry/CapabilityPlanner (Sources/AuraIntent/CapabilityRegistry.swift, CapabilityPlanner.swift) replace the closed five-intent ToolRouter switch; ToolRegistry/ToolContract were deleted (not left as dead code); InitialCapabilitySet registers 14 manifests (10 truthfully .ready, 4 truthfully .disabled with no adapter yet); 5 new direct, policy-gated AuraKernel methods give 4 more capabilities real reachability outside the NLU classifier; ADR-038 documents the design and known gaps. New CapabilityRegistryTests/CapabilityPlannerTests cover the required fail-closed/versioning/validation/cycle/fingerprint list; all pre-existing suites pass unchanged. Full regression run twice: 20/20 bundles, 717/717 tests, no flakiness. R3 is NOT complete: filesystem/URL adapters are unbuilt, the 4 newly-ready direct-call capabilities have no NLU/UI reachability yet, the planner is not wired into DialogueEngine/ToolRouter for real multi-step natural-language plans, and the required 7-scenario live completion demonstration has not been performed. Do not claim R2 or R3 complete before their respective remaining items are resolved or explicitly accepted.
